title: CIA — Tim Witness, Karma, Debt, Role & Attribute Taxonomy
status: canonical project-interpretive taxonomy with source boundaries
purpose: Define how CIA dossiers preserve Tim's own moral/spiritual observations about fruit, karma, debt, Dog/Mud-Dweller/Footstool roles, Tree-of-Strife relation, symbolic attributes, repair and transformation without converting those project judgments into independent clinical, legal or supernatural facts.
epistemic_rule: Tim/project classifications are archived as attributed witness. A role, attribute or debt relation may be meaningful inside the Potatoverse without being an externally established fact about a real person.

dweller.definition: One who inhabits a relational field; morally neutral until the field/orientation is specified.

mud_dweller.definition: One who has made unresolved Mud into a dwelling rather than transforming it.
mud_dweller.canonical_food_or_input: Tree of Strife — repeated conflict, degraded information, grievance, outrage, reaction, accusation, old screenshots/jokes/claims and status from opposition.
mud_dweller.user_canon_rule: A Mud Dweller is someone who has eaten from the Tree of Strife in Tim's symbolic grammar.
inheritance: Tree-of-Strife eater / participant in that symbolic input relation
mud_dweller.reversibility: Mud Dweller is a state, not an immutable human essence. Exit remains recognition → source-checking → truth/accounting → Door → root → sprout → Tree → fruit.

dog.definition: Boundary-responsive role organized around tracking, vigilance, pursuit, signaling, loyalty, cue-following and master/proxy relation.
dog.user_canon_rule: Anything that becomes a Dog was a Mud Dweller first; therefore every Dog inherits Mud-Dweller status for the relevant dated project layer.

variants.farm_dog: Pursuit/enforcement captured by Farm, proxy or pack incentives; tends toward enclosure, harvest and repeated target availability.
variants.guardian_dog: Vigilance redirected toward protection, evidence discipline, proportional warning and a real stopping condition.

dog.reversibility: Dog can become Guardian Dog, Farmer, Footstool or leave the role through recognition/changed conduct. Dog is not a species or permanent caste.

footstool.definition: Lower/subordinate or supporting state containing an unfound Door; not a statement of human worth.
footstool.reversibility: Footstool → recognition of center → Door → changed state.

farmer.definition: Infrastructure/enclosure/classification/harvest role that sets incentives, archives, access or repeated attention capture.
farmer.relation_to_mud: A Farmer becomes Mud-Dweller-like when the Farm becomes identity/home and resolution threatens belonging/status/income.

current_global_project_ledger.latest_direct_checkpoint: ~42 trillion symbolic karmic debt / reciprocal positive karma owed to Tim, late Aug–1 Sep 2026
current_global_project_ledger.boundary: These are project-symbolic moral/spiritual accounting figures, not financial liabilities.

debt_model.individual_rule: Never allocate a share of the global karmic ledger to a named person unless Tim explicitly assigned that person an amount. Mention count, dislike, Dog status or conflict co-presence are not sufficient to create a number.

statuses.explicit_individual_amount: Tim explicitly assigns a quantified karmic amount to this figure.
statuses.named_counterparty: Tim explicitly names the figure as part of an owed-debt / repair relation, but no individual amount may be known.
statuses.role_associated_debt: A dated Tim-assigned role (for example Farm Dog) is part of the project behavior family described as debt-producing; no individual amount inferred.
statuses.debt_producing_episode: A bounded episode contains Tim-attributed inputs such as smear, humiliation, dogpiling, wasted time, repeated accusation, blocked exit or refusal of accountability.
statuses.repair_credit: A later episode produces growth, truth, restitution, protection, useful work, apology, return or changed behavior that Tim's framework treats as generative/repairing.

episode_attributes.rule: Attributes attach to dated scenes/functions, never automatically to the whole person. Preserve Tim's wording where recoverable and use neutral functional labels when wording is interpretive.

projection_or_externalization.definition: Attributing unwanted qualities, motives or responsibility outward in a way Tim/project interprets as avoiding self-reflection.
projection_or_externalization.caution: Do not diagnose psychological projection from disagreement alone.

deflection_or_avoidance.definition: Moving away from the specific claim/evidence/accountability question rather than resolving it.
observable_forms: returning to old conflict instead of current evidence

deceit_or_falsehood.definition: A claim Tim says is false, fabricated or knowingly misleading.
deceit_or_falsehood.caution: Store as 'Tim disputes/labels this claim false' unless independent evidence establishes falsity or intent. Do not infer perpetual lying.

mud_throwing_or_smear.definition: Tim's symbolic family for accusation, humiliation, hostile framing, reputational residue or degraded information thrown into a relation.
mud_throwing_or_smear.caution: Must preserve whether the underlying claim is disputed, verified, or unresolved.

repetition_or_looping.definition: Returning to the same conflict, accusation, target or archive without transformation or stopping condition.

pack_cue_following.definition: Repeating group/proxy frames or outsourcing judgment to pack approval rather than direct source-checking.

extraction_or_harvest.definition: Turning a person's reaction, attention, image, archive or vulnerability into repeated value/status/spectacle.

building_or_repair.definition: Creating useful structure, protection, tools, rooms, food, art, clarity or conditions for independent growth.

confession_or_accountability.definition: Acknowledging one's own role, error, private material or obligation and changing relation accordingly.
confession_or_accountability.relation: Common exit from Dog/Mud loop in project stories.

ritual_rule.rule: Record 'ritual' only as the source frames it. A Chronicle calling a repeated social call a ritual does not establish occult ritual practice.

categories.literal_documented_ritual: Only where a source establishes an actual ritual and its actions.
categories.tim_interpreted_ritual: Tim or Chronicle interprets an event as ritualized; archive preserves that interpretation.
categories.symbolic_or_literary_ritual: Mythic/creative ritual inside Great Book or later story.
categories.satanic_ritual_claim: Preserve only as Tim's testimony/interpretation unless external evidence independently establishes the event.

ritual_rule.example_2025_02_27: The Chronicle calls three conflict calls 'rituals'; the bounded calls are the historical recovery target, while ritual meaning remains authored interpretation.
ritual_rule.example_2025_02_28: Chronicle says Tim spoke about experiences he interpreted as satanic ritual abuse; preserve as Tim/project testimony, not an established external finding.

multiple_archetype_rule: A figure may hold multiple roles at once or change roles across dates. The dossier should prefer dated role stacks over one permanent label.
inheritance_display_rule: When a dossier has an explicit Dog assignment, CIA may display inherited Mud-Dweller + Tree-of-Strife relation for that same project layer, marked as taxonomy inheritance rather than a second independent observation.
anti_dehumanization: Dog, Mud Dweller, Footstool, Farmer, Cow and related labels are project-relational roles. They do not lower human worth and do not justify harassment, humiliation or collective punishment.
